issue_title: Persistent sub-85 performance on / and /projects/screenshot-to-primevue (LCP bottleneck, day 5)
issue_body: ## Performance regression — persistent LCP bottleneck (day 5) Two pages have remained below the 85 Lighthouse performance threshold for **five consecutive nightly audits**. LCP continues to be the primary drag on both pages. | Page | Perf | LCP | TBT | CLS | |------|------|-----|-----|-----| | `/` | 84 | 3871 ms | 140 ms | 0.015 | | `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 80 | 4330 ms | 136 ms | 0 | Additionally, `/projects/note-structurer` has slipped back to 83 (from 87 yesterday) with LCP rising to 3920 ms — worth monitoring. ### Recommended fixes 1. **`fetchpriority="high"`** on each page's LCP `` element — ensures the browser prioritises the hero image over other in-flight requests. 2. **Preload the LCP image** with `` in the document ``. 3. **Check image sizing/format** — confirm hero images are served as WebP/AVIF at an appropriate resolution for mobile viewports. 4. For `/`, investigate whether the animated hero section delays LCP discovery; consider inlining critical CSS for above-the-fold content. ### Audit history - 2026-10-06: / perf 82, screenshot-to-primevue perf 79 - 2026-10-07: / perf 82, screenshot-to-primevue perf 79 - 2026-10-08: / perf 83, screenshot-to-primevue perf 77 - 2026-10-09: / perf 82, screenshot-to-primevue perf 80 - 2026-10-10: / perf 84, screenshot-to-primevue perf 80 _Automatically filed by nightly auditor — 2026-10-10T14:28:45.610Z_
